title: MSVC error output through SCons has broken encoding with Chinese language
body:
### Tested versions

enviroment:
- Windows 11 with Chinese language
- Visual Studio 2022
- SCons: v4.8.1.08661ed4c552323ef3a7f0ff1af38868cbabb05e, Tue, 03 Sep 2024 17:46:32 -0700, by bdbaddog on M1Dog2021
- SCons path: ['C:\\Python312\\Lib\\site-packages\\SCons']
- Python 3.12.6


### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6636) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-13600KF (20 threads)

### Issue description

When I compile a custom Godot using `scons platform=windows dev_mode=yes`, if there are some errors in my codes, scons will output some messy code. I guess it is related to my computer's language which is Chinese because the same code compiled by Github Action will output normal error information. But unfortunately, my Windows 11 license only supports one display language so I can't confirm by changing it to English.

Normal output by Github Action:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/aad8e0ee-b0ab-4367-a543-f28f0036c64e)

Messy code on my computer from both Visual Studio 2022's terminal and normal terminal:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2600a4df-5913-41e8-a100-054f87b2c629)
